repo.name: spring-petclinic
repo.summary: Server-rendered Spring Boot sample: owners, their pets and vet visits, edited through Thymeleaf forms. One JPA aggregate (Owner → Pet → Visit) is loaded eagerly and saved as a whole; vets are read-only and cached.

readingPath.title: The Owner aggregate
readingPath.note: Pets and visits are cascaded from Owner; every write goes through OwnerRepository.save.

readingPath.title: Booking a visit end to end
readingPath.note: Shows the @ModelAttribute pre-load pattern every owner/pet form uses.

readingPath.title: Visits must be in the future
readingPath.note: The only business rule enforced in a controller.

readingPath.title: How data and caching are set up
readingPath.note: Profile-selected database and the single 'vets' cache.

components.name: Owner & Pet Web
components.summary: MVC controllers for finding/editing owners, adding pets and booking visits. Each handler re-loads the Owner through @ModelAttribute methods instead of using session state.
responsibilities: Pet and visit forms with server-side validation

components.name: Thymeleaf Views
components.summary: Server-rendered templates with shared layout fragments, SCSS compiled to petclinic.css, and message bundles for i18n.

components.name: Vets
components.summary: Read-only vet list as HTML and JSON. The repository is cached under 'vets', so data changes are invisible until the cache is evicted.

components.name: Owner Aggregate
components.summary: Owner, Pet, Visit and PetType entities plus OwnerRepository. Owner is the aggregate root: pets and visits are EAGER-fetched and cascaded, so saving an owner persists everything beneath it.

components.name: Base Entities
components.summary: @MappedSuperclass bases (BaseEntity id, NamedEntity, Person) shared by all entities.

components.name: Platform
components.summary: Boot application, JCache 'vets' cache, locale switching, error/crash pages and native-image hints. The database is selected by Spring profile (h2 default, mysql, postgres).

components.name: Schema & Seed Data
components.summary: Hand-written schema.sql and data.sql per database; Hibernate DDL generation is off, so these files are the schema.

components.name: Relational DB
components.summary: H2 in-memory by default; MySQL or PostgreSQL via profile.

components.name: Software factory tooling
components.summary: The codebase map toolkit, the fence, the gardener's formal model and the agent skills installed by the software factory. Changes here go to the code owner (CODEOWNERS).

flows.name: Book a visit
flows.summary: The owner is re-loaded before the handler runs, the visit date is validated in the controller, and the whole Owner aggregate is saved to persist one visit.

steps.action: loadPetWithVisit pre-loads Owner and Pet, attaches a new Visit
processNewVisitForm rejects dates that are not in the future
Owner.addVisit finds the pet and appends the visit
OwnerRepository.save cascades to pets and visits

flows.name: Find owners
flows.summary: Prefix search on last name, 5 per page; exactly one hit redirects straight to that owner.

steps.action: processFindForm normalises input and pages results

snippets.title: Owner cascades pets and visits
snippets.why: The only write path: saving an Owner persists every pet and visit beneath it.

annotations.note: EAGER + cascade ALL: loading an owner loads all pets; saving it saves them.

snippets.title: Visit booking and date rule
snippets.why: The visit-date rule lives in the controller, not the entity — other write paths would skip it.

annotations.note: Dates today or earlier are rejected: only future visits can be booked.
Saves the whole Owner to persist one Visit.

snippets.title: Pre-load before every handler
snippets.why: @ModelAttribute methods run before each request handler; this is how forms get fresh entities without session state.

annotations.note: Owner is fetched on every request, including GETs.

snippets.title: Owner search and pagination
snippets.why: One endpoint serves list, empty-result and single-hit redirect behaviours.

annotations.note: Exactly one match redirects to the owner page instead of listing.

snippets.title: Vets are cached
snippets.why: Both queries are cached under 'vets'; there is no eviction, so DB edits don't appear until restart.

decisions.title: Schema is owned by SQL scripts, not Hibernate
decisions.decision: spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=none; schema.sql/data.sql per database are run at startup.
decisions.consequences: Entity changes need matching edits in three schema files.

decisions.title: Owner is the only write path
decisions.context: There is no Pet or Visit repository.
decisions.decision: All writes go through OwnerRepository.save with cascading associations.
decisions.consequences: Simple, but every visit booking loads and saves the full owner graph.

risks.title: Eager owner graph on every request
risks.detail: Owner → Pets → Visits are all EAGER; owner pages and every form load the full history. Fine for a sample, costly at real data volumes.

risks.title: All actuator endpoints exposed
risks.detail: management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=* — the file itself warns not to ship this to production.

glossary.definition: A booked appointment for one pet; must be dated in the future.
A vet's area of expertise, many-to-many with Vet.

questions.q: Should past-dated visits really be rejected?
questions.context: The rule in processNewVisitForm forbids recording a visit that already happened.
